data_routes_supported.review_queue: review context, counts, review tab and severity/type summaries
data_routes_supported.markdown_notes: read_note, frontmatter tags, wikilinks, note_path links
data_routes_supported.ingestion_graph: SP086 path short-circuits build_graph when ingestion_graph.json exists

obsidian_import_role: canonical author-facing VaERL-like projection with canonical_name, preferred_slug, entity_kind, aliases, summary, key_facts, relationships, review_state and chapters
review_queue_role: human review backlog and context, not graph primary source
ingestion_graph_role: viewer-ready graph input; currently projection can be synthetic and bypass canon counters
overview_uses: Project summary and semantic health based mostly on obsidian_import/review_queue/canon/health artifacts
graph_tab_uses: state.current.graph nodes/edges from build_graph; ingestion_graph takes precedence if present
detail_panel_uses: node.entity, node.chapter, note_path, canonicalization payload and source_refs if present
artifacts_tab_uses: raw 99_System JSON listing and JSON/text reader
legacy_or_misaligned_components: overview counters tied to primaries/review_items only
artifacts as main fallback for author review
duplicated_responsibilities: canon graph builder and ingestion_graph adapter both define graph semantics
writer outcome status separate from viewer overview counters
